programme.title: Foo Fighters - Austin City Limits
programme.desc: The Austin City Limits Music Festival is an annual music festival that takes place at Zilker Park in Austin, Texas. The festival features more than 130 bands on eight stages for three days.

programme.title: Motörhead - Rock Im Park
programme.desc: Rock im Park is a music festival that takes place in Nuremberg, Germany, lasting three days; featuring: Motörhead.

programme.title: Beck -- Live in London 2014
programme.desc: Filmed at Roundhouse, London, this concert film will give all fans an experience; Beck performs his hits including "Loser," "Wave," "Debra" and many more.

programme.title: Depeche Mode - Rock Am Ring
programme.desc: Rock Am Ring and Rock Im Park are annual music festivals at the Nürburgring racetrack in western Germany; Depeche Mode performs at the event.

programme.title: Pork Chop Hill
programme.desc: Gregory Peck heads an all-star cast in this true re-enactment of the terrifying Korean War that brilliantly pulls the viewer inextricably into the crossfire that surrounds American foot soldiers.

programme.title: The Train
programme.desc: Screen greats Burt Lancaster, Paul Scofield and Jeanne Moreau star in this suspense-laden tale of justice and retribution as a French Resistance fighter (Lancaster) attempts to stop a Nazi commander from looting the art treasures of Paris.

programme.title: The Bridges at Toko-Ri
programme.desc: This masterful story of a war-weary World War II veteran who must leave his family to fight again combines moving drama with surefire, bombs-away aerial action. Also starring Grace Kelly as his loving, luminescent wife.

programme.title: Braveheart
programme.desc: William Wallace, a commoner, unites the 13th Century Scots in their battle to overthrow English rule.

programme.title: Flight of the Intruder
programme.desc: The target: a missile depot in Hanoi. The plane: the A-6 Intruder, a low-altitude bomber with no defensive weapons. The risk: court-martial at the hands of Commander Camparelli...if they live to return.

programme.title: Homefront
programme.desc: A former DEA agent relocates his family to a small Louisiana town in hopes of starting a new life. There, he finds himself face-to-face with a local drug kingpin out for revenge after discovering the agent's past cases in this crime thriller.

programme.title: In Fabric
programme.desc: A lonely divorcée visits a bewitching London department store to find a dress to transform her life. She finds a perfect, artery-red gown that unleashes a malevolent, unstoppable curse in this frightening, seductive, and darkly funny tale.

programme.title: Urban Legend
programme.desc: When New England college student Natalie finds herself at the center of a series of sadistic murders seemingly inspired by urban legends, she resolves to find the truth about Pendleton's own legend. Rated: R

programme.title: Urban Legends: The Final Cut
programme.desc: Amy (Jennifer Morrison), Travis (Matthew Davis) and Graham (Joseph Lawrence) would love to make it big in Hollywood. First, they must survive their last semester at Alpine University, where their thesis films will vie for the prestigious Hitchcock Award.

programme.title: State Property
programme.desc: Beans decides that the only way to grasp the American Dream is to take it. STATE PROPERTY follows Beans and his crew, as they take over the city creating mayhem as their empire builds.

programme.title: State Property 2: Blood on the Streets
programme.desc: Three gangsters vie for power in Philadelphia.

programme.title: Caught Up
programme.desc: After being released from prison a man finds himself caught up in a love triangle.

programme.title: Legend of the Fist: The Return of Chen Zhen
programme.desc: Incredible martial arts sequences mark this thriller about a legendary fighter who takes on ruthless outside oppressors in World War II-era Shanghai.

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: Set in 198 A.D., when the Eastern Han Dynasty has collapsed into civil war, and the young Emperor is a puppet of prime minster and generalissimo Cao Cao (Jiang), the film singles out two famous chapters from Guan’s (Yen) many heroic adventures.

programme.title: Dragon
programme.desc: Liu Jin-xi (Donnie Yen) is a village craftsman whose quiet life is irrevocably shattered by the arrival of two notorious gangsters in the local general store.

programme.title: Major League
programme.desc: The new owner of the Cleveland Indians threatens to move the team unless they deliver immediate results. She then fills the roster with has-beens to guarantee their failure. But the team miraculously rallies together and starts to win.

programme.title: Nacho Libre (ENG)
programme.desc: Jack Black is more hilarious than ever as Ignacio, a monastery cook who feeds orphan children by day and by night transforms himself into Nacho Libre, a notorious Luchador in stretchy pants.

programme.title: 12 Pound Balls (2017)
programme.desc: It takes BALLS to win! At least that's what Gunnar thought before Emily came back. Now that she's returned to resurrect her name on the champion's board, Gunnar and the boys are polishing up their equipment for a shot at the title.

programme.title: Muriel's Wedding
programme.desc: In this perfect marriage of feel-good comedy and heartfelt drama, a shy daydreamer finds the courage to leave on a tropical vacation, where she meets a wacky new friend, changes her name, and turns her world upside down, all to an ABBA soundtrack.

programme.title: How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days
programme.desc: A "How to..." columnist agrees to write a first-hand account about what it takes to drive a man out of your life... in exactly 10 days.

programme.title: Failure to Launch
programme.desc: Tripp, a 35 year-old who still lives with his parents. And who can blame him. It’s free, he’s got a great room, and mom does the laundry. Desperate to get him out of the house, his parents hire a gorgeous woman, Paula, to give him a little…push.

programme.title: The Pallbearer
programme.desc: Nothing like death to put some life into romance: a hapless 25-year-old's fortunes change when he is a pallbearer for someone he doesn't know. David Schwimmer, Gwyneth Paltrow.

programme.title: Hannibal
programme.desc: Dr. Hannibal Lecter (Anthony Hopkins) comes out of hiding to draw FBI Agent Clarice Starling (Julianne Moore) into a high-stakes battle that tests her strength, cunning...and loyalty. Gary Oldman, Ray Liotta and Giancarlo Giannini also star.

programme.title: Payback
programme.desc: After a successful heist, Porter is left for dead. Once he recovers, he seeks vengeance and wants his share of the money.

programme.title: Primal Fear
programme.desc: Courtroom thriller about a slick, hotshot lawyer (Richard Gere) who takes the seemingly unwinnable case of a young altar boy (Edward Norton) accused of murdering an eminent catholic priest.

programme.title: Past Lives
programme.desc: Nora & Hae Sung, two deeply connected childhood friends, are wrest apart after Nora's family emigrates from South Korea. Decades later, they are reunited for one fateful week as they confront destiny, love, and the choices that make a life.

programme.title: Licorice Pizza
programme.desc: Licorice Pizza' is the story of Alana Kane and Gary Valentine growing up, running around and falling in love in the San Fernando Valley, 1973. Written and Directed by Paul Thomas Anderson, the film tracks the treacherous navigation of first love.

programme.title: Stepmom
programme.desc: An unlikely friendship develops when a mother of two is forced to teach another woman to raise her kids. Julia Roberts and Susan Sarandon star.

programme.title: Hondo
programme.desc: John Wayne plays Hondo Lane, a cavalry rider who becomes the protector of Angie Lowe as well as a father figure to her boy, Johnny. Angie, determinedly awaiting the return of her husband, refuses to leave their homestead despite the growing danger.

programme.title: The Sons of Katie Elder
programme.desc: The four rowdy sons of Katie Elder return home for her funeral and to avenge her death.

programme.title: El Dorado
programme.desc: Robert Mitchum plays to perfection an alcoholic but gutsy sheriff who relentlessly battles the dark side of the wild West, ruthless cattle barons and crooked “businessmen.”

programme.title: Push
programme.desc: Superhumans defy a government plot to harness and abuse their powers. Chris Evans and Dakota Fanning (the TWILIGHT films) team in a pulse-pounding paranormal thriller.

programme.title: Alex Rider: Operation Stormbreaker
programme.desc: After his uncle dies, a young boy learns of his relative's true occupation as an undercover spy and is later recruited to be undercover himself. Based on the novel by Anthony Horowitz.

programme.title: G.I. Joe: The Rise Of Cobra
programme.desc: They are G.I. Joe, a top-secret elite strike force featuring the best operatives from around the globe. After a secret weapon is stolen by the evil Cobra, the G.I. Joes must stop Cobra from plunging the world into chaos.

programme.title: The Guilt Trip
programme.desc: "Barbra Streisand and Seth Rogen are the perfect comedy duo"* as they embark on one mother of a road trip! When Andy invites his mom on an 8-day, 3,000-mile journey across the country, the farther they go, the closer they get. *Jake Hamilton, FOX-TV

programme.title: Blended
programme.desc: After a disastrous blind date, single parents Jim and Lauren never want to see each other again. But when they each sign up separately for a family vacation, they find themselves stuck sharing a suite at a luxurious African safari resort.

programme.title: Catch Me If You Can
programme.desc: From three-time Oscar-winning director Steven Spielberg, Catch Me If You Can follows Frank W. Abagnale, Jr. as he successfully passes himself off as a pilot, a lawyer, and a doctor - all before his 21st birthday!

programme.title: The New Adventures of Old Christine
programme.desc: Max (recurring guest star ERIC McCORMACK) points out to Christine her tendency to flake when things get tough, and tries to teach her how to follow through.

programme.title: The New Adventures of Old Christine
programme.desc: Richard asks Christine to set him up on a date to help him get over New Christine. Guest star (and real-life wife of series star Clark Gregg) JENNIFER GREY appears as his date.

programme.title: The New Adventures of Old Christine
programme.desc: Barb insists that Christine join her on a date with Dave (recurring guest star JAMES LESURE - For Your Love, Las Vegas), the immigration officer she has been seeing.

programme.title: The New Adventures of Old Christine
programme.desc: When Christine finds out Ritchie is the school bully, she decides to set a good example by making amends with the woman (AMY SEDARIS) she bullied as a kid.

programme.title: The New Adventures of Old Christine
programme.desc: Christine attends her neighborhood Christmas party where she learns a juicy secret about her neighbor. MOLLY SHANNON (Saturday Night Live) guest stars.

programme.title: The New Adventures of Old Christine
programme.desc: Christine tells her therapist she's in love with him, but his response is not what she expected. Recurring guest star ERIC McCORMACK appears as Max, Christine's therapist.

programme.title: The New Adventures of Old Christine
programme.desc: Christine finds herself falling in love with Max (ERIC McCORMACK) until her ex-boyfriend, Mr. Harris (BLAIR UNDERWOOD), comes back into her life.

programme.title: Moesha
programme.desc: Moesha gets birth control pills when she decides she would like to lose her virginity to Aaron. However, things get complicated when Dee finds the pills in her purse.

programme.title: Moesha
programme.desc: Moesha, Hakeem, and the other employees of the Class Act are held hostage by a man dressed as Santa Claus protesting age discrimination.

programme.title: Surfer, Dude
programme.desc: Longboarding soul surfer Steve Addington (Matthew McConaughey) returns to Malibu for the summer to find his cool hometown vibe corrupted.

programme.title: The Chumscrubber
programme.desc: The suicide of a teenage drug dealer sets off an unusual chain of events involving a kidnapping, mistaken identity and a rescue mission in this darkly comic satire starring Jamie Bell, Glenn Close and Allison Janney.

programme.title: Party Girl
programme.desc: In this raucous comedy, Parker Posey ("Scream 3") stars as a hard-partying NY club girl who takes a job as a librarian.

programme.title: The Woman in Black 2: Angel of Death
programme.desc: 40 years after the first haunting at Eel Marsh House, a group of children evacuated from WWII London arrives, awakening the house's darkest inhabitant.

programme.title: Hereditary
programme.desc: When the matriarch of the Graham family passes away, her daughter (Toni Collette) and grandchildren begin to unravel cryptic and increasingly terrifying secrets about their ancestry, trying to outrun the sinister fate they have inherited.

programme.title: Pet Sematary
programme.desc: Based on the terrifying novel by Stephen King... After the Creed family moves to rural Maine, they stumble upon an ancient burial ground with sinister powers. When tragedy strikes, a perilous chain of events unleashes an unfathomable evil.

programme.title: Hamburger Hill
programme.desc: On the 11th May 1969, troops of the 101st airborne division engaged the enemy at the base of Hill 937 in the Ashau Valley. Ten days and eleven bloody assaults later, the troops who fought there called it Hamburger Hill.

programme.title: Salvador
programme.desc: Compelling drama based on the real experinces of journalist Richard Boyle in strife-ridden El Salvador in 1980-81.

programme.title: Red Dawn
programme.desc: The outbreak of World War III has occurred, leaving a group of mid-Westernrn high school students turned refugees to slowly organize themselves into an effective guerilla force.

programme.title: Operation Condor
programme.desc: Jackie Chan ignites the big screen as the world's greatest secret agent, code name Condor. Sent to track down stolen Nazi gold, he is pursued by a ruthless band of treasure-hunting terrorists on a globe-spanning quest to reach the bounty first!

programme.title: Operation Condor II: The Armour Of The Gods
programme.desc: Jackie Chan is a fortune hunter whose ex-girlfriend is kidnapped by an evil cult! Things kick into high gear when her fiancée, an old friend of Jackie’s, asks him for help in securing the kidnappers’ lone demand: the priceless Armor of The Gods!

programme.title: Congo
programme.desc: When an explorer’s quest for a diamond mine ends tragically in the Congo, his father and the operation’s CEO sends Dr. Karen Ross, into the jungle to continue the hunt…maybe for his son, but definitely for the diamonds.

programme.title: Better Luck Tomorrow
programme.desc: To his classmates and teachers, high-schooler Ben Manibag appears to be the model student: a perfectionist and overachiever. But underneath this persona is a darker side. Ben and his bored high-school buddies lead double lives.

programme.title: Mob Town
programme.desc: The FBI and a local cop track various members of organized crime families as they gather for a huge meeting in upstate New York in 1957.

programme.title: Seven Psychopaths
programme.desc: A struggling screenwriter inadvertently becomes entangled in the Los Angeles criminal underworld after his oddball friends kidnap a gangster's beloved Shih Tzu.

programme.title: High And Low
programme.desc: An executive of a Yokohama shoe company becomes a victim of extortion when his chauffeur's son is kidnapped by mistake and held for ransom.

programme.title: Lady Snowblood
programme.desc: A young woman is trained from birth to be a deadly instrument of revenge against the swindlers who destroyed her family.

programme.title: A Fistful Of Dollars
programme.desc: The Man With No Name (Clint Eastwood) receives offers from two gangs terrorizing a small town and accepts both, setting in motion a plan to destroy the criminals in a series of brilliantly orchestrated setups, showdowns, and deadly confrontations.

programme.title: Jawbreaker
programme.desc: "The beautiful ones. The flawless four. Everyone wanted to be them. You know 'em". First there's Courtney "Satan-in-heels" Shayne and her pawn, the dense but dangerous Marcie Fox, a legend in her own little mind. Rated: R

programme.title: Fatal Instinct
programme.desc: Carl Reiner directs this side-splitting spoof that stars Armand Assante, Sean Young and a host of familiar faces in a series of suspense-thriller parodies.

programme.title: Galaxy Quest
programme.desc: Nearly twenty years after the cult TV show Galaxy Quest was cancelled, the alumni cast is asked for help by an alien species in order to save the universe.

programme.title: Multiplicity
programme.desc: Michael Keaton and Andie MacDowell star in director Harold Ramis' brilliant comedy about a man who clones himself to save his marriage, and then almost loses his wife to himself! Keaton takes on four hilariously distinct roles.

programme.title: Grease
programme.desc: Grease is the one that you want! Go back to high school with Pink Lady Sandy (Olivia Newton-John), leader of the bad-boy T-Birds, Danny (John Travolta), and a rockin' and rollin' all-star cast.

programme.title: Hair
programme.desc: A country boy and Vietnam draftee embark on an adventure of a lifetime when he meets a group of counterculture hippies and his eyes are opened to the darker side of class, race, and big city life in this adaptation of the Broadway sensation.

programme.title: Cheech & Chong's Still Smokin
programme.desc: It's Cheech and Chong at their wildest, craziest, most medicated, doing all those zonked-out characters and hilarious routines that put them where they are today: out of the country.

programme.title: Ghost In The Shell
programme.desc: 2029 – A female government cyber agent and the Internal Bureau of Investigations are hot on the trail of a "The Puppet Master" – a computer virus capable of invading cybernetic brains and altering its victim’s memory.

programme.title: Cyborg
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme stars in this adrenaline-charged sci-fi thriller as Gibson Rickenbacker, the future's most fearsome warrior. In the wake of a plague, Rickenbacker must rescue the only person who can develop a vaccine and save civilization.

programme.title: Tank Girl
programme.desc: In this laugh-a-minute, futuristic thriller, a mega-villain controls the world's water supply, and it's up to Tank Girl and her outrageous cohorts to end his greedy reign.

programme.title: Eagle Eye
programme.desc: Shia LaBeouf and Michelle Monaghan star as two strangers trying to escape danger when they are ripped from their ordinary lives and 'activated' as part of a hightech assassination plot.

programme.title: Disturbia
programme.desc: Living under three months' house arrest, Kale Brecht (Shia LaBeouf, Transformers) passes his days spying on the neighbors. It's all fun and games until things take a horrifying turn for the worse.

programme.title: War of the Worlds

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Cosmic Rainbow
programme.desc: The human eye can only see visible light, a small spectrum of electromagnetic waves. Today, we have instruments that let us perceive all wavelengths.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Seasons of Saturn
programme.desc: Saturn is the second largest planet and has an astonishing 60 moons in its orbit. Thanks to the Cassini mission, it’s also one of the most studied and most photographed planets in our neighborhood.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Vesta Unveiled
programme.desc: With the Dawn missions exploration of the asteroid Vesta and the dwarf planet Ceres, asteroids are a hot topic. See what these incredible missions have uncovered.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Water Worlds
programme.desc: They key ingredient to life in the universe is water. Until recently we thought Earth was the only place in the solar system to have any water at all. Now that probes are peering around nearby worlds we are finding that is just not the case.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Gravity
programme.desc: Gravity has long been a force that has intrigued scientists. Now, for the first time scientists are probing to detect gravity waves in space as well as mapping the gravity patterns of the moon.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Science and the Shuttle
programme.desc: For more than 25 years the shuttle was our ticket to space, and our laboratory in orbit. Uncover the legacy of this amazing machine, and see what lies ahead.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landing on Mars
programme.desc: Mars sparks our curiosity like no other planet because it is so reachable. Despite having landed there, most of the information we gather is still done by instruments in the planet's orbit.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Milky Way
programme.desc: This episode traces our view of the Milky Way, from the mythology of ancient skywatchers to the efforts of scientists to map it from the inside out.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Big Bang
programme.desc: When it comes to the birth of the universe, not even the most creative work of imagination can rival what science has revealed about the Big Bang.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Intruso Invisible

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos

programme.title: Depeche Mode - Rock Am Ring
programme.desc: Rock Am Ring and Rock Im Park are annual music festivals at the Nürburgring racetrack in western Germany; Depeche Mode performs at the event.

programme.title: Alice in Chains - Unplugged
programme.desc: In their first live concert in over 2 years (and possibly their last concert ever), Alternative/metal group Alice in Chains performs acoustically at MTV Unplugged. Includes acoustic versions of their hits.

programme.title: Matchbox Twenty - Live in London 2012
programme.desc: Filmed at Roundhouse, London, this concert film will give all fans an experience from start to finish; Matchbox Twenty performs their hits including Bright Lights, Parade, You're So Real, and more.

programme.title: The Bridges at Toko-Ri
programme.desc: This masterful story of a war-weary World War II veteran who must leave his family to fight again combines moving drama with surefire, bombs-away aerial action. Also starring Grace Kelly as his loving, luminescent wife.

programme.title: Attack
programme.desc: Eddie Albert is a cowardly captain, Lee Marvin a crooked colonel, and Jack Palance a diligent lieutenant as a small platoon fights its way back from the front in director Robert Aldrich's searing WWII drama.

programme.title: Hell Is For Heroes
programme.desc: It's 1944, and Nazi forces along the Siegfried Line have the numbers, the fortifications and the firepower to break through. GIs have little more than a dogged determination and the ingenuity to fool the Germans into thinking they are allies.

programme.title: Flight of the Intruder
programme.desc: The target: a missile depot in Hanoi. The plane: the A-6 Intruder, a low-altitude bomber with no defensive weapons. The risk: court-martial at the hands of Commander Camparelli...if they live to return.

programme.title: Homefront
programme.desc: A former DEA agent relocates his family to a small Louisiana town in hopes of starting a new life. There, he finds himself face-to-face with a local drug kingpin out for revenge after discovering the agent's past cases in this crime thriller.

programme.title: Braveheart
programme.desc: William Wallace, a commoner, unites the 13th Century Scots in their battle to overthrow English rule.

programme.title: Urban Legends: The Final Cut
programme.desc: Amy (Jennifer Morrison), Travis (Matthew Davis) and Graham (Joseph Lawrence) would love to make it big in Hollywood. First, they must survive their last semester at Alpine University, where their thesis films will vie for the prestigious Hitchcock Award.

programme.title: Urban Legends: Bloody Mary
programme.desc: On a prom-night dare, a trio of high-school friends chant an incantation, unleashing an evil spirit from the past with deadly consequences.

programme.title: Carrie (2013)
programme.desc: Chloë Grace Moretz and Julianne Moore star in this exhilarating reimagining of Stephen King's iconic best-seller, 'Carrie.' After merciless taunting and abuse, events spiral out of control until the terrifying conclusion of this horror story.

programme.title: Caught Up
programme.desc: After being released from prison a man finds himself caught up in a love triangle.

programme.title: Paid in Full
programme.desc: A young man from Harlem, forced to cope with the 1980s drug scene, builds an illegal empire, only to have a crisis of conscience. Featuring the hit soundtrack with songs by Eric B. & Rakim, Boogie Down Productions, Guy, and Jay-Z.

programme.title: King of New York
programme.desc: Recently freed from prison, Frank White (Christopher Walken) begins to exterminate the drug lords who rose to power in his absence. When a group of enraged cops declares war on him, Frank's answer is to put a contract out on the cops.

programme.title: Dragon
programme.desc: Liu Jin-xi (Donnie Yen) is a village craftsman whose quiet life is irrevocably shattered by the arrival of two notorious gangsters in the local general store.

programme.title: Special ID
programme.desc: An undercover cop (Donnie Yen) infiltrates one of China's most ruthless crime syndicates. He must risk everything to protect his family and his life after the boss (Collin Chou) vows to find and kill every traitor in his organization.

programme.title: Raging Fire
programme.desc: Shan (Donnie Yen) is a hardline cop with a long history of success, but his past comes back to haunt him when a sting is attacked by a group led by his former protégé (Nicholas Tse), a man set on destroying everyone who ever wronged him.

programme.title: 12 Pound Balls (2017)
programme.desc: It takes BALLS to win! At least that's what Gunnar thought before Emily came back. Now that she's returned to resurrect her name on the champion's board, Gunnar and the boys are polishing up their equipment for a shot at the title.

programme.title: Major League
programme.desc: The new owner of the Cleveland Indians threatens to move the team unless they deliver immediate results. She then fills the roster with has-beens to guarantee their failure. But the team miraculously rallies together and starts to win.

programme.title: Nacho Libre (ENG)
programme.desc: Jack Black is more hilarious than ever as Ignacio, a monastery cook who feeds orphan children by day and by night transforms himself into Nacho Libre, a notorious Luchador in stretchy pants.

programme.title: Failure to Launch
programme.desc: Tripp, a 35 year-old who still lives with his parents. And who can blame him. It’s free, he’s got a great room, and mom does the laundry. Desperate to get him out of the house, his parents hire a gorgeous woman, Paula, to give him a little…push.

programme.title: The Pallbearer
programme.desc: Nothing like death to put some life into romance: a hapless 25-year-old's fortunes change when he is a pallbearer for someone he doesn't know. David Schwimmer, Gwyneth Paltrow.

programme.title: Muriel's Wedding
programme.desc: In this perfect marriage of feel-good comedy and heartfelt drama, a shy daydreamer finds the courage to leave on a tropical vacation, where she meets a wacky new friend, changes her name, and turns her world upside down, all to an ABBA soundtrack.

programme.title: Primal Fear
programme.desc: Courtroom thriller about a slick, hotshot lawyer (Richard Gere) who takes the seemingly unwinnable case of a young altar boy (Edward Norton) accused of murdering an eminent catholic priest.

programme.title: Shutter Island
programme.desc: When U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels arrives at the asylum for the criminally insane on Shutter Island, he uncovers terrifying truths about the island and finds out some places never let you go.

programme.title: Point Break
programme.desc: An F.B.I. Agent goes undercover to catch a gang of surfers who may be bank robbers.

programme.title: Licorice Pizza
programme.desc: Licorice Pizza' is the story of Alana Kane and Gary Valentine growing up, running around and falling in love in the San Fernando Valley, 1973. Written and Directed by Paul Thomas Anderson, the film tracks the treacherous navigation of first love.

programme.title: Stepmom
programme.desc: An unlikely friendship develops when a mother of two is forced to teach another woman to raise her kids. Julia Roberts and Susan Sarandon star.

programme.title: Ginger & Rosa
programme.desc: In 1962 London, the lifelong friendship between two teenagers (Elle Fanning, Alice Englert) dissolves after one seduces the other's father.

programme.title: Janet Planet
programme.desc: 11-year-old Lacy spends the long summer at home with her mother and three strangers, in Pulitzer Prize winner Annie Baker's sublime debut film, capturing a child's experience of time and her vivid interior world.

programme.title: El Dorado
programme.desc: Robert Mitchum plays to perfection an alcoholic but gutsy sheriff who relentlessly battles the dark side of the wild West, ruthless cattle barons and crooked “businessmen.”

programme.title: True Grit (1969)
programme.desc: The cantankerous Rooster is hired by a headstrong young girl (Kim Darby) to find the man who murdered her father and fled with the family savings.

programme.title: Hondo
programme.desc: John Wayne plays Hondo Lane, a cavalry rider who becomes the protector of Angie Lowe as well as a father figure to her boy, Johnny. Angie, determinedly awaiting the return of her husband, refuses to leave their homestead despite the growing danger.

programme.title: G.I. Joe: The Rise Of Cobra
programme.desc: They are G.I. Joe, a top-secret elite strike force featuring the best operatives from around the globe. After a secret weapon is stolen by the evil Cobra, the G.I. Joes must stop Cobra from plunging the world into chaos.

programme.title: G.I. Joe: Retaliation
programme.desc: The greatest American Heroes are back and they've been set up to take the fall for a heinous crime they didn't commit. Roadblock (Dwayne Johnson) leads a new team (including Channing Tatum and Bruce Willis) on this high-octane adventure.

programme.title: Project Almanac
programme.desc: When five teens discover a machine that can send them back in time, the possibilities seem endless. But by changing the past, they have threatened the future of our world. Can they undo the damage they have unleashed before it’s too late?

programme.title: Catch Me If You Can
programme.desc: From three-time Oscar-winning director Steven Spielberg, Catch Me If You Can follows Frank W. Abagnale, Jr. as he successfully passes himself off as a pilot, a lawyer, and a doctor - all before his 21st birthday!

programme.title: How Stella Got Her Groove Back
programme.desc: Stella's vacation to Jamaica takes a hot and steamy turn when she encounters a young islander.

programme.title: The Guilt Trip
programme.desc: "Barbra Streisand and Seth Rogen are the perfect comedy duo"* as they embark on one mother of a road trip! When Andy invites his mom on an 8-day, 3,000-mile journey across the country, the farther they go, the closer they get. *Jake Hamilton, FOX-TV

programme.title: Moesha
programme.desc: Moesha, Hakeem, and the other employees of the Class Act are held hostage by a man dressed as Santa Claus protesting age discrimination.

programme.title: Moesha
programme.desc: A friend of Myles who has a crush on Moesha pretends he cannot read so she can tutor him. However, after an article she writes about the success she has had with the little student is published in the LA Times, Moesha learns a hard lesson.

programme.title: Moesha
programme.desc: Hakeem accepts a job as assistant manager of the Class Act claiming there are financial difficulties at home. Moesha, concerned about his college education, confronts his mother who denies his claims.

programme.title: Moesha
programme.desc: Racial tensions mount in Moesha’s high school after a mural depicting Latin American hero Caesar Chavez is purposely defaced.

programme.title: Moesha
programme.desc: After Moesha and Kim have a huge fight, Moesha is surprised when MTV shows up at her door to film her bringing her best friend Kim to meet her favorite singer. Leanne Rimes guest stars.

programme.title: Moesha
programme.desc: Moesha wants to boycott her debutante ball when she learns one of the girls is thrown out of the ceremony because she is pregnant.

programme.title: Sabrina: The Teenage Witch
programme.desc: Sabrina finds herself in a little trouble when she sneaks out of the house after being grounded.

programme.title: Sabrina: The Teenage Witch
programme.desc: Sabrina is put on trial for witchcraft when her class visits historical Salem, Massachusetts.

programme.title: Sabrina: The Teenage Witch
programme.desc: When Sabrina is tricked into marrying a troll, only a prince – a.k.a. Harvey – can save her.

programme.title: Party Girl
programme.desc: In this raucous comedy, Parker Posey ("Scream 3") stars as a hard-partying NY club girl who takes a job as a librarian.

programme.title: The House Of Yes
programme.desc: Marty just wants a normal life, but that blows up when he brings his fiancée home to meet his far-from-normal family. Soon, Mother is hiding the kitchen knives, but she can't hide the family's shockingly hilarious secrets!

programme.title: Heathers
programme.desc: Winona Ryder, Christian Slater, and Shannen Doherty star in this cruelly hilarious dark comedy, which became one of the biggest cult classics of the `80s.

programme.title: Hereditary
programme.desc: When the matriarch of the Graham family passes away, her daughter (Toni Collette) and grandchildren begin to unravel cryptic and increasingly terrifying secrets about their ancestry, trying to outrun the sinister fate they have inherited.

programme.title: Pet Sematary
programme.desc: Based on the terrifying novel by Stephen King... After the Creed family moves to rural Maine, they stumble upon an ancient burial ground with sinister powers. When tragedy strikes, a perilous chain of events unleashes an unfathomable evil.

programme.title: The Woman in Black
programme.desc: Author Kipps (Daniel Radcliffe), a widowed lawyer, is sent to a remote village to sort out the affairs of a recently deceased eccentric. But upon his arrival, it soon becomes clear that everyone in the own is keeping a deadly secret.

programme.title: Red Dawn
programme.desc: The outbreak of World War III has occurred, leaving a group of mid-Westernrn high school students turned refugees to slowly organize themselves into an effective guerilla force.

programme.title: A Soldier's Story
programme.desc: A fine drama set during World War II, in which a black military attorney investigates the death of a black sergeant. The lawyer eventually discovers that the sergeant was both ashamed of his own culture and virulently hated by his men.

programme.title: Hamburger Hill
programme.desc: On the 11th May 1969, troops of the 101st airborne division engaged the enemy at the base of Hill 937 in the Ashau Valley. Ten days and eleven bloody assaults later, the troops who fought there called it Hamburger Hill.

programme.title: Congo
programme.desc: When an explorer’s quest for a diamond mine ends tragically in the Congo, his father and the operation’s CEO sends Dr. Karen Ross, into the jungle to continue the hunt…maybe for his son, but definitely for the diamonds.

programme.title: The Tuxedo
programme.desc: Simmy Tong is an ordinary cabbie-turned-chauffeur who slips into a 2-billion-dollar, super-spy suit and inadvertently becomes a dashing secret agent.

programme.title: Operation Condor
programme.desc: Jackie Chan ignites the big screen as the world's greatest secret agent, code name Condor. Sent to track down stolen Nazi gold, he is pursued by a ruthless band of treasure-hunting terrorists on a globe-spanning quest to reach the bounty first!

programme.title: Mob Town
programme.desc: The FBI and a local cop track various members of organized crime families as they gather for a huge meeting in upstate New York in 1957.

programme.title: Seven Psychopaths
programme.desc: A struggling screenwriter inadvertently becomes entangled in the Los Angeles criminal underworld after his oddball friends kidnap a gangster's beloved Shih Tzu.

programme.title: Better Luck Tomorrow
programme.desc: To his classmates and teachers, high-schooler Ben Manibag appears to be the model student: a perfectionist and overachiever. But underneath this persona is a darker side. Ben and his bored high-school buddies lead double lives.

programme.title: We Own the Night
programme.desc: What if your own family stood in the way of everything you worked for? Bobby Green (Joaquin Phoenix) has forsaken his name to escape his family and their tradition in law enforcement to pursue his ambitions as a Brooklyn nightclub owner. Rated R

programme.title: Lady Snowblood
programme.desc: A young woman is trained from birth to be a deadly instrument of revenge against the swindlers who destroyed her family.

programme.title: A Fistful Of Dollars
programme.desc: The Man With No Name (Clint Eastwood) receives offers from two gangs terrorizing a small town and accepts both, setting in motion a plan to destroy the criminals in a series of brilliantly orchestrated setups, showdowns, and deadly confrontations.

programme.title: For A Few Dollars More
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood returns as the Man With No Name, who teams up with equally lethal Colonel Mortimer (Lee Van Cleef) in pursuit of a sadistic killer and his band of desperadoes in this non-stop action classic from legendary director Sergio Leone.

programme.title: Galaxy Quest
programme.desc: Nearly twenty years after the cult TV show Galaxy Quest was cancelled, the alumni cast is asked for help by an alien species in order to save the universe.

programme.title: Multiplicity
programme.desc: Michael Keaton and Andie MacDowell star in director Harold Ramis' brilliant comedy about a man who clones himself to save his marriage, and then almost loses his wife to himself! Keaton takes on four hilariously distinct roles.

programme.title: Encino Man
programme.desc: Two high school buddies dig up a frozen caveman in their backyard!

programme.title: Galaxy Quest
programme.desc: Nearly twenty years after the cult TV show Galaxy Quest was cancelled, the alumni cast is asked for help by an alien species in order to save the universe.

programme.title: Hair
programme.desc: A country boy and Vietnam draftee embark on an adventure of a lifetime when he meets a group of counterculture hippies and his eyes are opened to the darker side of class, race, and big city life in this adaptation of the Broadway sensation.

programme.title: Cheech & Chong's Still Smokin

programme.title: El Fantástico Jaspion

programme.title: Heidi: Clara
programme.desc: A la llegada de Heidi a Frankfurt será compañera de una niña llamada Clara que esta en una silla de ruedas.

programme.title: Heidi: El campanario
programme.desc: Heidi quiere subir al campanario para ver si logra ver las montañas, desafortunadamente no puede pero encuentra 2 gatitos uno para ella y otro para Clara los cuales deben esconder de la señorita Rottenmeier.

programme.title: Heidi: La promesa
programme.desc: La señorita Rottenmeier es alérgica a los gatos, pide a Sebastian que los ahogue y encierra a Heidi en el sotano como castigo. Clara ayuda a que Heidi escape para salvar a los gatitos.

programme.title: Heidi: El regreso de papá
programme.desc: Es impresionante el avance que a tenido Clara desde que llegó Heidi, Clara teme que su padre quiera expulsar a Heidi, asi que decide mostrarle ella misma que puede ir sola a la ciudad a comprar su pastel favorito.

programme.title: Heidi: Estudiando en casa
programme.desc: El maestro de Clara regresa de sus vacaciones, para su sorpresa Heidi aún no sabe leer ni escribir por lo que tendrán que separar a las dos amigas ya que su nivel escolar es diferente.

programme.title: Heidi: Preparando un espectáculo
programme.desc: La abuela de Clara llega a cambiar el ambiente de la casa, se da cuenta que el maestro es muy académico. Gracias a la obra que la abuela le enseña a Heidi ella aprender a leer, la abuela se encargará de la educación de las chicas.

programme.title: Heidi: En el parque
programme.desc: Heidi y Clara salen al parque, las chicas conocen a Rudy. Heidi y Rudy van corriendo jugando y Clara trata de alcanzarlos, lamentablemente Clara cae de su silla de ruedas, queda lastimada y Heidi está preocupada ya que a lo mejor Clara y no podrá caminar.

programme.title: Heidi: Clara se pone de pie
programme.desc: Despúes de su accidente Clara no quiere salir de su habitación. La abuela y Heidi intentan animarla pero no lo logran, en secreto Clara esta practicando para poder volver a caminar.

programme.title: Heidi: Cabras en la ciudad
programme.desc: Heidi y Clara dan una vuelta de nuevo por el parque, descubren que el parque hay cabras, pero la más bebé esta enferma. Heidi se la lleva a casa para curarla pero debe apresurarse antes de que regrese la señorita Rottenmeier.

programme.title: Heidi: La renuncia
programme.desc: La señorita Rottenmeier regresa y se da cuenta que Heidi tiene a una cabra bebé. Heidi decide irse a vivir con Rudy y tomar un tren para regresar a las montañas. Rottemeier le da una segunda oportunidad a Heidi.

programme.title: Rugrats
programme.desc: Hugo es golpeado en la cabeza y sufre una amnesia temporal, por lo que empieza a comportarse como un bebé nuevamente. / Los Pickles hacen una venta de garaje, y los Rugrats ayudan reuniendo las cosas de los adultos.

programme.title: Rugrats
programme.desc: Mientras Hugo prueba un nuevo juguete electrónico, accidentalmente corta la electricidad de la ciudad entera. / Los niños confunden un cajero automático de un banco por una de caramelos.

programme.title: Rugrats
programme.desc: Angélica le explica a Tommy que todos los padres regalan a sus hijos a otros padres en las reuniones familiares. / Al cuidado del Abuelo, Tommy y Carlitos se preparan para una excitante noche de películas y helado.

programme.title: Rugrats
programme.desc: En el Museo de Historia Natural, Tommy y sus amigos buscan un hueso para Firulais. / Carlitos cree que los animales son más felices en el océano. Cuando le regalan unos peces, emprende la misión de llevarlos de vuelta al mar.

programme.title: Rugrats
programme.desc: Los Rugrats encuentran una pequeña lagartija y creen que es el bebé de Reptar. / Cuando un juego de adivinanzas se pone demasiado intenso, los Pickles y los DeVilles no se hablan más.

programme.title: Rugrats
programme.desc: Los Rugrats convencen a Carlitos que él se puede convertir en superhéroe si se pone una capa violeta. / Cuando Firulais empieza a tener olor feo, Didi contrata a un peluquero de perros para que lo bañe.

programme.title: Rugrats
programme.desc: Después de ver una película de ciencia ficción sobre hormigas gigantes del espacio, Tommy y Carlos quedan asustados. / Inspirados por una película de ciencia ficción, los Rugrats deciden usar un "rayo vago" para convertirse en miniaturas.

programme.title: Rugrats
programme.desc: Didi conoce al famoso cuidador de niños, el Dr. Lipschitz, y lo invita a cenar a su casa. / Los Rugrats fantasean en cómo sería ser adultos y deciden que es mejor ser bebés.

programme.title: Naruto: Aprobar o reprobar un Examen De Supervivencia
programme.desc: Naruto, Sasuke y Sakura son un equipo, se encuentran con su sensei, Kakashi, él propondrá un examen que solo dos de ellos pueden aprobar, enviando al estudiante que falla a la Academia Ninja. ¡Ellos no saben que alguien haya pasado la prueba de Kakashi!

programme.title: Naruto: ¡Fallaste! La Decisión Final De Kakashi
programme.desc: Naruto, Sasuke y Sakura hacen todo lo posible para aprobar el examen de supervivencia. ¡Pero serán necesarios los sabios consejos de Kakashi para enseñarles a estos ninjas egoístas lo que significa trabajar en equipo!

programme.title: Naruto: ¡Una Misión Peligrosa! Un Viaje A La Tierra De Las Olas
programme.desc: Naruto y sus compañeros comienzan sus primeras misiones ninja. Son tareas aburridas, enojadas y frustradas, y Naruto se alivia diciéndole todo al Hokage. Entretenido por el entusiasmo de Naruto, les asigna una nueva misión: proteger al viejo Tazuna.

programme.title: Naruto: El Asesino De La Neblina
programme.desc: Naruto y su grupo llegan a Tierra de las Olas,donde un malvado hombre llamado Gato se apodero del lugar. Allí aparece Zabuza, contratado por Gato para matar a Tazuna. Naruto está deseando enfrentarse a este asesino ninja. ¿Estará listo para este desafío?

programme.title: Naruto: El Juramento Del Dolor
programme.desc: Kakashi se pone delante durante la batalla contra Zabuza. Pero ¡todo cambia cuando Kakashi es atrapado en la Prisión de Agua de Zabuza! Kakashi pide que huyan, pero Naruto recuerda la promesa que hizo -no volver a huir nunca más- y se mantiene firme!

programme.title: Naruto: Kakashi: Guerrero Sharingan
programme.desc: Gracias al plan de Naruto, Kakashi se libera de la Prisión de Agua y derrota a Zabuza. Un misterioso ninja aparece de repente y acaba con Zabuza antes de que Kakashi lo haga. Naruto se sorprende al ver que un muchacho ha podido derrotar a Zabuza.

programme.title: Naruto: El Bosque Del Chakra
programme.desc: Kakashi no está satisfecho con el resultado de la batalla, cree que Zabuza no ha muerto. Kakashi decide poner en marcha un interesante entrenamiento que permitirá a Naruto, Sasuke y Sakura controlar mejor su chakra.

programme.title: Naruto: El País Donde Existió un Héroe
programme.desc: Sakura y Tazuna van a la aldea, y ven sufrimiento de habitantes de la Tierras a causa de Gato, por eso Tazuna arriesga su vida. Con un puente, los habitantes no dependerían de Gato, quien controla todos los negocios. Naruto y Sasuke continúan entrenando.

programme.title: Naruto: ¡Batalla En El Puente! ¡Zabuza Regresa!
programme.desc: Mientras Naruto se concentra en el entrenamiento, una misteriosa figura aparece y le dice que si alguien tiene el deseo de proteger lo que ama, puede llegar a ser tan fuerte como quiera.

programme.title: Heidi: Un árbol como refugio

programme.title: Heidi: El fantasma

programme.title: Heidi: La carta

programme.title: Heidi: De regreso en Dörfli

programme.title: Heidi: Una nueva cabra en el rebaño

programme.title: Heidi: La estatua rota

programme.title: Heidi: El prendedor

programme.title: Heidi: Prueba escolar

programme.title: Heidi: La búsqueda del tesoro

programme.title: Naruto: ¡Batalla En El Puente! ¡Zabuza Regresa!
programme.desc: Mientras Naruto se concentra en el entrenamiento, una misteriosa figura aparece y le dice que si alguien tiene el deseo de proteger lo que ama, puede llegar a ser tan fuerte como quiera.

programme.title: Naruto: Las Armas Conocidas Como Shinobi
programme.desc: Haku le pide a Naruto que lo termine. Naruto cuestiona a Haku y su existencia solo para luchar y ganar. Kakashi y Zabuza alcanzan el clímax y Kakashi retiene el movimiento de Zabuza. Con la victoria a su alcance, lanza su devastador ataque.

programme.title: Naruto: El Demonio De La Nieve
programme.desc: Naruto enfrenta a Zabuza. Aunque parece no tener emociones, Zabuza está desolado por la pérdida de Haku, la única persona del mundo en la que podía confiar. Naruto se da cuenta de que esta cruel realidad es el destino de los ninjas.

programme.title: Naruto: Un Nuevo Capítulo Comienza: El Examen Chunin
programme.desc: Naruto y compañia regresan a la Aldea Escondida entre las Hojas después de su batalla en la Tierra de las Olas. Aunque cumplen las misiones, Naruto no está satisfecho. Pronto descubre que los extraños están apareciendo en el Leaf Village.

programme.title: Naruto: Identifíquense: Nuevos Y Poderosos Rivales
programme.desc: Naruto, Sasuke y Sakura son de los elegidos para tomar el Examen Chunin, pero Iruka se opone a que participen. Son muy jóvenes y carecen de la experiencia y habilidades necesarias. Kakashi piensa que están listos para afrontar el desafío.

programme.title: Naruto: Reto Chunin: Rock Lee Versus Sasuke
programme.desc: Mientras se preparan para el examen, Rock Lee entra en escena. Lee quiere enfrentarse a Sasuke, quien guarda el poder del Clan Uchiha. Sasuke acepta el reto pero los ataques de su oponente son tan rápidos que lo único que puede hacer es defenderse.

programme.title: Naruto: ¡La Batalla Genin! Los Nueve Novatos Se Enfrentan
programme.desc: Naruto, Sasuke y Sakura se inscriben al Examen Chunin, en el tres ninjas deben formar equipo y ninguno puede fallar. El trabajo en equipo es indispensable. Se quedan estupefactos al ver que hay muchos otros que persiguen el mismo sueño.

programme.title: Naruto: Enciendan Motores: Los Examenes Chunin Comienzan
programme.desc: Naruto y su equipo comienzan la prueba, un examen escrito. El examinador es un jonin llamado Ibiki. Aprobar el examen depende de los tres. Sasuke y Sakura están preocupados de que si Naruto responde mal, también fallarán.

programme.title: Naruto: La Décima Pregunta: Todo O Nada
programme.desc: La parte más difícil es la pregunta número 10. Antes de que escuchen la pregunta, Ibiki explica una regla muy severa: si responden mal a la pregunta, reprobarán el primer examen y el equipo perderá el derecho de tomar otros Exámenes en el futuro.

programme.title: Naruto: Reporte Especial: ¡En Vivo Desde El Bosque De La Muerte!
programme.desc: Konohamaru, el nieto del Tercer Hokage de la Aldea de la Hoja, aparece en el Examen, junto con Moegi y Udon, para cubrir los eventos en el periódico de la Academia Ninja. Konohamaru admira a Naruto y hace entrevistas a los personajes.

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: Pokémon: Los Viajes Johto
programme.desc: Tras una advertencia en el bosque sobre un travieso Pokémon tipo Fantasma, nuestros héroes llegan a un pueblo donde todos usan tipos Psíquico para repelerlos. Pronto llegan temibles noticias: ¡un Gengar gigante anda suelto!

programme.title: Pokémon: Los Viajes Johto
programme.desc: Una repentina moda en la adivinación Pokémon resulta ser un plan para robar a los Pokémon de los Entrenadores locales. Pero esta vez Jessie, James y Meowth no son los responsables. ¿Quiénes son estos villanos?

programme.title: Pokémon: Liga de Campeones Johto
programme.desc: Tras llegar a Ciudad Caña Dorada, Ash está listo para su próxima batalla de Gimnasio, pero el Gimnasio parece estar cerrado. Con sus planes retrasados, nuestros héroes deciden explorar la vibrante ciudad.

programme.title: Pokémon: Liga de Campeones Johto
programme.desc: Tras perder contra Whitney en el Gimnasio Caña Dorada, Ash quiere una revancha con su poderosa Miltank. Cuando Whitney sugiere un viaje a una lechería de Miltank, esa es la oportunidad que él estaba buscando.

programme.title: Pokémon: Liga de Campeones Johto
programme.desc: Con su nueva medalla de Gimnasio en mano, a Ash le piden participar en una estación de radio local. Pero mientras actúa en un drama de radio con algunos "actores profesionales", el peligro descrito se vuelve demasiado real.

programme.title: Pokémon: Liga de Campeones Johto
programme.desc: Un Concurso de Atrapar Pokémon Insecto se vuelve un enjambre de actividad cuando Ash se enfrenta a su rival Casey... y pronto el Equipo Rocket se presenta en escena, tratando de capturar algo para ellos…

programme.title: Pokémon: Liga de Campeones Johto
programme.desc: Camino a Ciudad Ecruteak, nuestros héroes quedan atrapados del lado incorrecto del río. Para cruzar, primero deben encontrar un Sudowoodo... ¡Eso no es fácil ni para un experto!

programme.title: Pokémon: Liga de Campeones Johto
programme.desc: Cuando un exalumno del Profesor Oak descubre Omanyte y Omastar salvajes restaurados, nuestros héroes son llamados a salvar a estos Pokémon prehistóricos de las penurias con el Equipo Rocket.

programme.title: Pokémon: Liga de Campeones Johto
programme.desc: El servicio de mensajería Pidgey Express necesita de la ayuda de nuestros héroes, especialmente cuando el Equipo Rocket quiere a los Pidgey mensajeros registrados, sellados y entregados al Jefe.

programme.title: Pokémon: Liga de Campeones Johto
programme.desc: Atrapados en una tormenta, nuestros héroes hallan un castillo clínica que usa Pokémon sanadores para ayudar pacientes. Pero cuando Brock y el doctor quedan atrapados en el laberinto del castillo, necesitarán ayuda para salir.

programme.title: El camino del cantábrico

programme.title: ABC Gourmet: Pescados y mariscos

programme.title: The Four 1

programme.title: The Big White
programme.desc: Un agente de viajes endeudado (Robin Williams) intenta conseguir un millón de dólares afirmando que un cadáver es su hermano desaparecido.

programme.title: Meet The Spartans
programme.desc: Parodia de "300" y otras películas. El rey Leónidas y su ejército de 12 hombres luchan contra Jerjes de Persia para defender la libertad de Esparta.

programme.title: Un Destino Compartido
programme.desc: La cómoda vida de un importante agente de talentos de Hollywood se ve amenazada cuando descubre que su mujer le está engañando y que un periodista le ha robado su diario para hundirlo.

programme.title: La Veganza De La Bruja
programme.desc: Tras la invasión rusa de Ucrania en febrero de 2022, una bruja de Konotop busca vengarse de los soldados rusos que asesinaron a su prometido.

programme.title: Alone
programme.desc: Una escritora, en busca de paz y soledad, se va al campo para terminar su libro y recuperarse de la tragedia. Su estancia se convierte en un infierno al darse cuenta de que sus demonios internos no son su peor problema.

programme.title: Las Voces
programme.desc: Jerry es un tipo alegre que trabaja en una fabrica de bañeras y tiene un encanto poco convencional. Con la ayuda de su psiquiatra, golpea a un compañero de trabajo. Pero la relacion toma un giro inesperado y asesino despues de que ella lo invita a salir.

programme.title: El incomprendido
programme.desc: Al trabajar en problemas derivados de su pasado, Tom Warshaw, un artista estadounidense que vive en París, comienza a descubrir quién es realmente y regresa a su casa para reconciliarse con su familia y amigos.

programme.title: The 5th Quarter
programme.desc: Impulsado por el trágico y fatal accidente automovilístico que le quitó la vida a su hermano Luke de quince años, y vistiendo la camiseta con el número 5 de Luke, Jon Abbate ayuda a liderar a los Wake Forest Demon Deacons.

programme.title: THE PERFECT GAME
programme.desc: Basado en una historia real. En 1957, un grupo de niños pobres de Monterrey, México, conmocionó al mundo al ganar 13 juegos seguidos y la Serie Mundial de Pequeñas Ligas en el único juego perfecto jamás lanzado en el Campeonato.

programme.title: Justicia verdadera
programme.desc: Kane y el nuevo equipo tienen que derrotar a un jefe de pandillas de alto nivel involucrado en el tráfico de personas, pero bajo investigación descubre una conspiración más grande que involucra el tráfico de órganos.

programme.title: Justicia verdadera
programme.desc: Kane y su equipo rastrean a un conocido traficante de órganos, que escapó del ataque y promete llevar a Kane un paso más cerca de The Ghost.

programme.title: Justicia verdadera
programme.desc: El experto en lavado de dinero personal de The Ghost debe llegar a la ciudad y Bojan, un fantasma del pasado de Kane aparece de repente en escena. La CIA está convencida de que Bojan ha venido a proteger al experto en lavado de dinero.

programme.title: Justicia verdadera
programme.desc: The Ghost está comprando y Kane se propone averiguar qué lo acerca más a The Ghost.

programme.title: Justicia verdadera
programme.desc: Kane cree que The Ghost está buscando comprar una maleta con bombas nucleares, que ha sido introducida de contrabando en el país y se propone rastrearla junto con su equipo.

programme.title: Justicia verdadera
programme.desc: Un policía encubierto se acerca a su némesis. Permite que un agente de su confianza entre al campo, pero tiene dudas si ella tiene lo que se necesita para completar la misión.

programme.title: The Sentinel
programme.desc: Un agente es culpado injustamente por planear el asesinato del presidente.

programme.title: Runaway Jury
programme.desc: Un miembro jurado se une a un "asesor" que trata de manipular el juicio

programme.title: The Code
programme.desc: En Nueva York, el experimentado ladrón de arte, Keith Ripley, invita al audaz ladrón de Miami, Gabriel Martin, a unirse a él.

programme.title: De Vuelta A América
programme.desc: Una familia india se muda a Estados Unidos con la esperanza de vivir el sueño americano. Mientras su hijo de 10 años se enamora perdidamente de su vecina, su deseo de convertirse en un «buen viejo» lo aleja más que nunca de los ideales de su familia.

programme.title: Tiempo de esperanza
programme.desc: Michael Thompson es un contador de una gran ciudad que cría solo a su hija adolescente, Chloe.

programme.title: Un verano inolvidable
programme.desc: La joven Kathy sueña con pasar el verano en el campamento ecuestre de Black River, un lugar reservado solo para niñas.

programme.title: Love Finds You in Sugarcreek
programme.desc: El jugador de béisbol Micah Matthias y su pequeño hijo Bobby huyen de los medios brutales tras el traumático y sin resolver asesinato de su esposa y madre.

programme.title: Encuentra el amor en Valentine
programme.desc: Kennedy Blaine hereda un magnífico rancho en la pequeña población de Valentine y decide visitar la propiedad para ponerlo en venta. Cuando llega, Derek, el capataz, la confunde con una intrusa y la relación no empieza con buen pie.

programme.title: Hielo
programme.desc: Nadya renuncia a su sueño de ser campeona de patinaje tras un accidente. Pero Sasha, un jugador de hockey, la inspira a creer y perseguir su sueño nuevamente.

programme.title: Hacker - Todo Crimen Tiene Um Inicio
programme.desc: Cuando su familia tiene problemas económicos, Alex Danyliuk busca una solución a la situación. Con la ayuda de Sye, un bandido que conoce los caminos del crimen en Internet, Alex descubre el mundo de los negocios del mercado negro en la red.

programme.title: Asesinatos del pasado
programme.desc: El detective Starks investiga misteriosos asesinatos muy similares a los cometidos por el asesino en serie Henry Lee Bishop. Mientras Starks intenta buscar respuestas, un chico sordo descubre a una universitaria que lucha por sobrevivir.

programme.title: Luna Llena
programme.desc: Un pistolero del salvaje oeste regresa de la tumba para evitar que una banda de hombres lobo sedientos de sangre aterrorice a un pequeño pueblo.

programme.title: Entrevista con Hitman
programme.desc: Un asesino a sueldo de élite regresa para borrar su pasado sólo para descubrir que alguien ha arruinado su futuro.

programme.title: Traición al Mayo Parte 3
programme.desc: La guerra entre familias del narcotráfico continua en Sinaloa, Joaquín junto a su hermanos Archí y Jonás preparan una alianza con el cartel de Guadalajara algo que inclinaría claramente la balanza de su lado en la guerra contra Israel Zavala.

programme.title: Traición al Mayo Parte 4

programme.title: Dog, el cazarrecompensas

programme.desc: Avdol diseña un plan para contrarrestar los ataques del Stand de agua, pero el enemigo se les adelanta. Mientras, el supuesto ayudante se queda dormido durante la pelea.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: Kakyoin y Avdol buscan tratamiento médico mientras el resto de los hombres entra sin darse cuenta en un bar donde les esperan dos hermanos usuarios de Stand.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: Cuando Jotaro y el equipo llegan a Lúxor, Joseph recibe una descarga al tocar una extraña piedra que lleva incrustada una toma de corriente eléctrica.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: Joseph y Avdol se quedan atrapados juntos por culpa de un Stand enemigo. Cuando finalmente logran separarse, los pies se les quedan enganchados en las vías del tren.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: Después de haber intentado sin éxito dar caza a un hombre que lo perseguía, Polnareff se da cuenta de que sus zapatos son varias tallas más grandes de lo que deberían.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure

programme.title: Heidi: El reto

programme.title: Heidi: Salvando a Pichi

programme.title: Heidi: El tesoro de Pedro

programme.title: Heidi: Ataque en la casa del árbol

programme.title: Enchufe.TV

programme.title: Enchufe.TV

programme.title: Enchufe.TV

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: Por más que lo evites en algún momento te verás obligado a enfrentar retos casi imposibles. Sin embargo, cuenta la leyenda que nada es más difícil que no ver este episodio de Enchufetv.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV

programme.title: Enchufe.TV

programme.title: Enchufe.TV

programme.title: Enchufe.TV

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure

programme.title: Heidi: El fin de la primavera

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
